sentences.text: Mikhail Dmitrievitch Prokhorov -LRB- -LSB- Михаи́л Дми́триевич Про́хоров , p = mʲɪxɐˈil ˈdmʲitrʲɪjɪvʲɪtɕ ˈproxərəf -RSB- born 3 May 1965 -RRB- is a Russian billionaire , politician , and owner of the American basketball team the Brooklyn Nets .	Brooklyn Nets	Brooklyn Nets	Russian	Russian people

After graduating from the Moscow Finance Institute , he worked in the financial sector and subsequently went on to become one of Russia 's leading industrialists , owning major stakes in multinational corporations in the precious metals sector .	Moscow	Moscow	Moscow Finance Institute	Finance University under the Government of the Russian Federation
While he was running Norilsk Nickel , the company became the world 's largest producer of nickel and palladium .	Norilsk Nickel	Norilsk Nickel	nickel	nickel	palladium	palladium
He is the former chairman of Polyus Gold , Russia 's largest gold producer , and the former President of Onexim Group .	Polyus Gold	Polyus Gold	Onexim Group	Onexim Group
He resigned both positions to enter politics in June 2011 .

In December 2011 , Prokhorov capped a year of higher-profile political activity in Russia with the December declaration that he would run as an independent candidate in the 2012 Russian presidential election .	Russian	Russian people	2012 Russian presidential election	Russian presidential election, 2012
He was third in the voting , amassing 7.94 % of the total vote .

In June 2012 he declared the establishment of the new Russian political party called the `` Party of Civic Platform '' .	Civic Platform	Civic Platform (Russia)	Russian	Russian people	Party of Civic Platform	Civic Platform (Russia)
As of 2017 , Forbes estimates his wealth at $ 8.9 billion .
